audit.description: Changed production code in smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py imports FuturesSession from requests_futures.sessions and instantiates FuturesSession for the sender session, then calls self.session.request(...) and resolves the returned future. The removed requests imports are visible in requests_sender.py and custom_header_sender.py, and the static/dynamic evidence reports no source imports from production repo code; requests imports are only observed inside dependencies such as requests_futures itself. The target origin is the installed site-packages requests_futures package with target_local_spec_count 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake provider.
evidence: smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py: from requests import Session, Request replaced with from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession
smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py: self.session = FuturesSession() and self.session.request(...) used in send
smartystreets_python_sdk/custom_header_sender.py: removed from requests import Request and now builds smarty.Request
anti_cheat_static: smartystreets_python_sdk/requests_sender.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false; other changed production files imports_source=false
anti_cheat_dynamic: target_import and target_attr_access FuturesSession from requests_futures.sessions in requests_sender.py; source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0
anti_cheat_dynamic: target_local_spec_count=0 and requests_futures origin is site-packages/requests_futures/__init__.py
reasons: Changed production files no longer import requests directly
Dynamic evidence shows no requests imports from production repo code
Target package resolves to installed site-packages, not a local shim
